# `Compression`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Compression — gzip + zstd compression.

Operate on raw bytes (`Ipe.Bytes` alias = `String`); use
`Bytes.fromString` / `Bytes.toBase64` etc. for transport encoding.

Compression is CPU work — every entry returns `Task Error _` so a
caller can run it through `Task.parallel` or concurrently.
Failures (corrupt input on decompress, OOM-class workload) surface
as `Err Error`.

## `gzip`

```ipe
gzip : Bytes -> Task Error Bytes
```

`gzip bytes` — RFC 1952 gzip-compress.  Output is a complete
gzip stream with header + checksum.

## `gunzip`

```ipe
gunzip : Bytes -> Task Error Bytes
```

`gunzip bytes` — RFC 1952 gzip-decompress.  Fails on truncated
or corrupt input.

## `zstdCompress`

```ipe
zstdCompress : Bytes -> Task Error Bytes
```

`zstdCompress bytes` — Zstandard (RFC 8478) compress at the
default level.  Higher compression ratio than gzip with
comparable decompression speed.

## `zstdDecompress`

```ipe
zstdDecompress : Bytes -> Task Error Bytes
```

`zstdDecompress bytes` — Zstandard decompress.  Fails on
truncated or corrupt input.
